labels.name: priority:P3
labels.description: Later, exploratory, duplicated, or uncommitted work.

labels.name: status:needs-grooming
labels.description: Outcome, scope, dependencies, or acceptance criteria need refinement.

labels.name: status:needs-evidence
labels.description: Decision or implementation claim lacks required evidence.

labels.name: status:needs-decision
labels.description: Material alternatives or authority remain unresolved.

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Blocked by a named unresolved dependency or condition.

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Sufficiently understood and unblocked for the next action.

labels.name: status:needs-validation
labels.description: Implementation exists but required evidence is incomplete.

labels.name: status:superseded
labels.description: Replaced by a named issue, decision, PR, or repository.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: New user, operator, or system capability.

labels.name: type:delivery
labels.description: Bounded cross-cutting implementation, integration, migration, or refactoring outcome.

labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: Coordinates a larger outcome across bounded child work.

labels.name: type:design
labels.description: Explores or proposes architecture or system behavior.

labels.name: type:qart
labels.description: Resolves one bounded decision through alternatives and trade-offs.

labels.name: type:security
labels.description: Security vulnerability, hardening, threat analysis, or control work.

labels.name: type:maintenance
labels.description: Dependency, compatibility, cleanup, or routine corrective work.

labels.name: type:release
labels.description: Release preparation, publication, or support action.

labels.name: area:governance
labels.description: Governance policy, authority, approval, and evidence.

labels.name: maturity:experimental
labels.description: Experimental and subject to significant change.

labels.name: maturity:incubating
labels.description: Incubating toward stable contracts and operation.
